info.name: Bin2Earn / GreenEco — Full API
info.description:
Complete collection by user flow. Pre-filled headers, bodies, pagination, filters.

Flow:
Register → Verify Email → Login → Profile → Address → Pickup → Bin Request → Rewards → Redeem

Admin:
Login → Dashboard → Pickups → Users → Drivers → Bins → Rewards → Reports

---

## Rate Limiting
- Auth routes (login, register, forgot-password, reset-password, resend-verification): **5 requests/minute**
- All other API routes: **60 requests/minute** per user (or per IP for unauthenticated)
- Returns `429 Too Many Requests` with `Retry-After` header on limit exceeded
